question: M Balamuralikrishna was awarded Padma Vibhushan in 1991 for which of the following fields?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Carnatic music**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **M Balamuralikrishna** was a renowned Indian musician, known for his contributions to **Carnatic music**, which is one of the two main subgenres of Indian classical music.
 
• He was an accomplished **vocalist, composer, and multi-instrumentalist**, with his works being recognized not just in India but globally.
